title: Is a Hot Dog a Sandwich? | Debate on YouTube Shorts

scenes.background_prompt: A simple flat illustration of a hot dog and a sandwich, with no characters present.

lines.speaker: Host
lines.text: Hey there! Today we’re tackling a question that has been debated by food enthusiasts everywhere: is a hot dog a sandwich?

scenes.background_prompt: Flat illustration of two food items side by side: a hot dog and an open sandwich.

lines.speaker: Host
lines.text: Now, the argument is that both contain meat between bread.

lines.speaker: Guest
lines.text: True, but sandwiches are typically served open-faced. Hot dogs have a casing!

scenes.background_prompt: Flat illustration of a hot dog bun and a sandwich bun.

lines.speaker: Host
lines.text: Okay, but what about the bun? Is it enough to make it a sandwich?

lines.speaker: Guest
lines.text: In sandwiches, the bread usually touches the top and bottom of the meat. Hot dogs often just slide right in!

scenes.background_prompt: Flat illustration of a hot dog on a bun with condiments.

lines.speaker: Host
lines.text: I get that. But what about the toppings? They’re basically the same, right?

lines.speaker: Guest
lines.text: That’s debatable! Some hot dogs have ketchup and mustard; others might just be spicy sausages!

scenes.background_prompt: Flat illustration of various condiments on a sandwich and a hot dog.

lines.speaker: Host
lines.text: Alright, let’s wrap this up. What’s the final call?

lines.speaker: Guest
lines.text: Well, it depends on your definition of a sandwich! But in my book, nope—it’s definitely not a sandwich!

outro_cta: Host: So, what do you think? Join the debate and leave your thoughts in the comments below. Don’t forget to like and subscribe for more fun food debates!
